deviations.why: Page-local convention (showcase :root comment 'per spec: not tokens'), keyed per theme, fading to transparent. The identity-board field is the visual thesis; its stops are derived-from-canvas atmosphere, not a palette.

The showcase demonstrates the per-product accent registry (design-language.md §Decision 2): spexr's indigo and introspect's cyan (plus derived hover/subtle) appear as demo swatch content, not as a second accent adopted by the showcase. Blessed by exact value, not selector — the swatches live in a JS object with no distinctive selector.
